hypothesis: Titles that match what the searcher actually typed will lift CTR toward the site own top-quartile rate at the same position. Baseline: these 16 pages carry ~98,000 Canadian impressions at ~0.5% CTR while sibling pages at the same positions earn 2.8-4.5%.
stopRule: At 6 weeks compare Canadian CTR per page against the baseline below, holding position roughly constant. If the set does not lift >=25% relative, revert the titles and stop the programme at 16 pages.
confound: Runs concurrently with the slug A/B test (data/exp-slug-test.json) but on a DISJOINT page set, so the two remain separately attributable.
note: Rendered SERP title = META_TITLE + " | BuzzSkito" (12 chars) via the app/layout.tsx template. Target <=60 RENDERED. Ten of these needed shortening after the agents optimised to the raw 60.
